# bootStateSpace

Ivan Jacob Agaloos Pesigan

## Description

Provides a streamlined and user-friendly framework for bootstrapping in
state space models, particularly when the number of subjects/units (n)
exceeds one, a scenario commonly encountered in social and behavioral
sciences. The parametric bootstrap implemented here was developed and
applied in Pesigan, Russell, and Chow (2025:
<https://doi.org/10.1037/met0000779>).

## Installation

You can install the CRAN release of `bootStateSpace` with:

``` r

install.packages("bootStateSpace")
```

You can install the development version of `bootStateSpace` from
[GitHub](https://github.com/jeksterslab/bootStateSpace) with:

``` r

if (!require("remotes")) install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("jeksterslab/bootStateSpace")
```

## More Information

See [GitHub Pages](https://jeksterslab.github.io/bootStateSpace) for
package documentation.

## Citation

To cite `bootStateSpace` in publications, please cite Pesigan et al.
(2025).

## References

Pesigan, I. J. A., Russell, M. A., & Chow, S.-M. (2025). Inferences and
effect sizes for direct, indirect, and total effects in continuous-time
mediation models. *Psychological Methods*.
<https://doi.org/10.1037/met0000779>

R Core Team. (2025). *R: A language and environment for statistical
computing*. R Foundation for Statistical Computing.
<https://www.R-project.org/>

# Package index

## Parametric Bootstrap

- [`PBSSMFixed()`](https://github.com/jeksterslab/bootStateSpace/reference/PBSSMFixed.md)
  : Parametric Bootstrap for the State Space Model (Fixed Parameters)
- [`PBSSMLinSDEFixed()`](https://github.com/jeksterslab/bootStateSpace/reference/PBSSMLinSDEFixed.md)
  : Parametric Bootstrap for the Linear Stochastic Differential Equation
  Model using a State Space Model Parameterization (Fixed Parameters)
- [`PBSSMOUFixed()`](https://github.com/jeksterslab/bootStateSpace/reference/PBSSMOUFixed.md)
  : Parametric Bootstrap for the Ornstein–Uhlenbeck Model using a State
  Space Model Parameterization (Fixed Parameters)
- [`PBSSMVARFixed()`](https://github.com/jeksterslab/bootStateSpace/reference/PBSSMVARFixed.md)
  : Parametric Bootstrap for the Vector Autoregressive Model (Fixed
  Parameters)

## State Space Model

- [`PBSSMFixed()`](https://github.com/jeksterslab/bootStateSpace/reference/PBSSMFixed.md)
  : Parametric Bootstrap for the State Space Model (Fixed Parameters)

## Vector Autoregressive Model

- [`PBSSMVARFixed()`](https://github.com/jeksterslab/bootStateSpace/reference/PBSSMVARFixed.md)
  : Parametric Bootstrap for the Vector Autoregressive Model (Fixed
  Parameters)

## Linear Stochastic Differential Equation Model

- [`PBSSMLinSDEFixed()`](https://github.com/jeksterslab/bootStateSpace/reference/PBSSMLinSDEFixed.md)

## Ornstein–Uhlenbeck Model

- [`PBSSMOUFixed()`](https://github.com/jeksterslab/bootStateSpace/reference/PBSSMOUFixed.md)
